title: feat: add cron, ffmpeg, uv and everyday tools to the sandbox templates
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added cron to sandbox templates, started by systemd, with a default user crontab PATH that lets scheduled jobs find node, polli and uv instead of searching only /usr/bin:/bin. Added ffmpeg, git-lfs, poppler-utils (including pdftotext), ripgrep, fd, sqlite3, tmux, nano, vim-tiny, htop, lsof, strace, dnsutils, netcat, zip, zstd, 7z, tree and bc. Added checksum-pinned uv 0.12.21 for Python tools, uvx MCP servers and Python versions newer than the base image’s 3.11; installing Python 3.13 was tested. Sandbox docs now list the tools and explain cron behavior while a sandbox is paused.

image.prompt: In a cozy sandbox workshop, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt and tends a code-plant beside a ticking cron clock and a terminal showing ffmpeg and uv. Keep her small-to-medium sized in the scene, strictly pixel art and never realistic, with chunky retro sprites, prominent lime green (#ecf874), soft pastel gradients, warm lighting and subtle CRT glow: cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
